objective: Define a controlled production rollout sequence for the landed Telnyx V2 webhook ingress without performing live configuration, deployment, provider registration, or production mutation.

runtimeRequirements.publicSigningKeySource: The Telnyx account V2 webhook signing public key

rolloutOrder: Confirm the landed Git revision and clean working tree.
Confirm the production RIVER_CRM_DB binding is unchanged and points to the intended CRM database.
Obtain the Telnyx V2 webhook Ed25519 public signing key from the intended Telnyx account.
Configure TELNYX_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY in the production Worker runtime without committing its account-specific value to Git.
Build the application from the exact approved revision.
Verify the deployed endpoint rejects unsigned requests before any D1 application.
Verify the deployed endpoint is reachable over HTTPS.
Register the deployed endpoint with the intended Telnyx voice application for V2 webhook delivery.
Perform a controlled end-to-end webhook validation.
Confirm canonical correlation, bridge reconciliation, attempt reconciliation, and receipt deduplication behave as designed.
rollback: If deployment validation fails before Telnyx registration, do not register the endpoint.
If provider registration has occurred and webhook handling is unhealthy, remove or replace the Telnyx webhook destination before further testing.
Do not mutate D1 schema as part of webhook rollout.
Do not change canonical event or reconciliation semantics during rollout.
Return to the last known-good deployed revision if application deployment itself introduced unrelated regressions.
